verdict.rationale: Wrike's own materials describe in-product AI insights: AI insights that turn raw work data into actionable intelligence, AI tools that predict risk and allocate resources in dashboards, and a Copilot that answers questions and summarizes work. These claims cover the core story directly, but they come from marketing-level pages rather than detailed documentation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how insights and suggestions are generated and surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration, and tier or availability details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Wrike AI insights turn raw work data into clear, actionable intelligence.
use our AI tools to predict risk and allocate resources
